title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Mr Blue 10ml E-Liquid
description: A bold and fruity medley, Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Mr Blue blends rich Blueberry, juicy Raspberry, and a subtle icy base. The deep berry notes create a vibrant and deliciously sweet inhale, while a cool exhale adds a refreshing finish, making this an ideal choice for fans of rich, punchy fruit flavours laced with ice. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers fast-acting nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures excellent flavour clarity while keeping vapour production discreet, making it a great match for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing popular flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
